english: Rem. There's something I want to ask you.\nDo you have a moment?
You want to ask me something? Now, what could it be?
Lately I've been having scary dreams.\nSo I thought I'd ask you about it, Rem.
I see. So that's it.\nWhen it comes to dreams, leave it to me.
So, you keep having scary dreams?\nYou must be under a lot of stress.
Huh, stress?
Yes, stress. Humans dream\nto relieve their stress.
Human sleep comes in two types.\nLight REM sleep,\nand deep non-REM sleep.
When you fall asleep, you first enter\nnon-REM sleep, and then\nmove into REM sleep.
The dreams you remember are said to be\ndreamt during light REM sleep.
But scary dreams can also be dreamt\nduring deep non-REM sleep.\nThere's research showing that.
And these REM and non-REM sleep stages\nare said to alternate every 90 minutes.
So, have you been able to\nfollow me so far, I wonder?
It's a bit hard to... follow...
Hmm. I see.\nI tried to keep it simple and careful...\nbut I guess not...
Maybe I explained it badly.\nSorry?
Yes. It's interesting, though.
Hehe. Good.\nThat makes me happy to hear!
You're dreaming scary dreams\nduring deep sleep.
You're dreaming scary dreams\nto relieve your stress.
I see...\nNow that you mention it, that does\nsound about right...
But that's just one possibility.\nThere's never just one cause for dreams.
Things happening in the real world,\npast memories, those are involved too...
Pinpointing 'this is the cause!'\nis pretty hard.
It's complicated...
It's interesting because it's complicated.\nDreams are so mysterious and wonderful!
Hehe.\nI ended up talking a lot before I knew it.
Wasn't it boring?\nAll that lecture-like talk.
No, no. It was interesting.\nI'd love to hear more of that kind of talk.
Really? Then,\nwant to study dreams with me in more detail?
May I?
Of course! Someone taking an interest\nin the dream world makes me\nso happy, you know.
Then, some other time.\nI'll think about what to talk about.
Look forward to it, okay?
Rem's study classs!
Haaai, how've you been?\nToday we'll study dreams with me\nlots and lots, okay.
(Rem looks like she's having fun.\nDoes she like this kind of thing?)
Well then, let's start\nwith the basics!
Here's a question.\nWhere, exactly, do humans dream?\nYes, you there!
Where... with our eyes?\nOh, but we're asleep, so our eyes are closed.\nUmmm...
Bzzzt. Time's up.\nYou'll have to study harder. Hehe.
The answer is: the brain.\nHumans dream in their brains.
The mechanism of dreaming and the human brain\nare said to be deeply connected.
For example, there's this hypothesis.\nThe mechanism by which humans dream\nis similar to a computer's offline processing.
Do you know what\noffline processing is, I wonder?
Yes. I sort of get it.
...Really?\nI didn't think you knew much\nabout computers.
This is study time, you know.\nThere's nothing embarrassing\nabout not knowing things, okay?
Sorry...\nI was bluffing a little...
Sorry. I don't know.
It's fine, it's fine. It's okay.\nBeing able to say you don't know something\nyou don't know is the mark of a good studentt.
We're studying to learn\nthe things we don't know, right?
Then shall I explain?
Offline processing means\nprocessing information internally\nwithout feeding in outside information.
And humans apparently do\nthis work in dreams.
Um, what does that mean?
In other words, while humans sleep,\nthe brain organizes information.
It pulls out all sorts of memories at random\nand deletes the unneeded information.\nGot it?
I sort of get the random part...\nAre dreams where the before and after\ndon't connect influenced by that?
Good question! Exactly right!
Because the brain's organizing is random,\nunrelated memories get linked together.
As a result, you get to experience\nan absurd world impossible in daily life.\nYou could call it one of dreams' great charms!
I seee. Interesting.
Hehe. I'm glad if you understand\neven a little of dreams' charm.
Teacher Rem. May I ask a question?
Hm? What is it?
Teacher Rem, what do you think\nis the number-one charm of dreams?
Hmm, the number-one charm...\nDreams have so many good points, but...\nlet's see...
No matter how romantic,\nno matter how impossible in reality,\nit can happen in a dream.
That freedom, I guess?
Oh. In dreams anything goes, right.\nImpossible things happen.
Right, right. You're\nsuch a quick, good studentt.
Oops, I talked too much again.\nLet's call it a day.
Will there be a next time?\nI'd like to hear about interesting dreams\nyou've experienced, Rem.
Interesting dreams I've experienced...\nthat'd turn into stories about cases\nI've worked.
Some are pretty scary cases, though. You okay with that?
It's fine. I'm not a kid.
Hehe. Then let me think a bit.\nSee you next time.
Rem. I came to hear about the case.
Welcome!\nNow, what should I talk about...
I've been involved in so many cases that\nwhen it's time to talk, I get stuck.
Any requests from you?\nWhat kind of story do you want to hear?
I'd like a story with lots of girls in it.
Jeez, what kind of request is thatt.\nAm I not enough of a girl on my own?
Well, speaking of stories with lots of girls,\nthere's a fitting case.
I'd like a story you feel strongly about, Rem.
A story I feel strongly about...\nEvery case is precious to me, but...
The one that comes to mind right now\nis that case, I guess?
That one was when\nI went undercover at a girls' high school.
Oh? Did your eyes light up\nat the words 'girls' high school,' I wonder?
If you're imagining anything weird,\nI'll get mad, okay? Hehe.
I-I'm not imagining anything weird!\nWhat kind of case was it?
That case was requested by\nInspector Sakaki, a detective I know.
I infiltrated an all-girls boarding school,\nand it was sooo tough.
And at the end, this huuuge\nrobot showed up.
R-robot?
Yep, yep.\nGood thing the missiles worked...
M-missiles?
But in the end, that case was\nthe story of one sad girl.
Because of this job of mine,\nI've seen all kinds of people's dreams.
Like the ghost of a fallen warrior\nwho died 800 years ago, or an android\nbuilt by a genius scientist...
(She really has lived through amazing things.)
There were lots of sad dreams, but\ndreams always leave hope at the end.
That's why I love dreams.\nI'm proud of this job of protecting dreams.
Wow. You're amazing, Rem...
Hm? What is?
You know so much about so many things,\nand you've had all these mysterious experiences.\nHonestly, I think that's cool.
Oh my. What's gotten into you all of a sudden.\nFlattery won't get you anything, you knoww.
I know a lot about dreams\nbecause it's my job.
Of course I've had mysterious experiences.\nI'm not an ordinary girl, after all.
But being called cool made me\na little happy.
Thanks.
No problem.\nI hope we keep getting along.
Yeah. See you.\nWhen you've got free time,\nlet's chat again, okay.
Ah, there's something I want\nto ask you, is that okay?
Rem wants to ask me something?\nWhat could it be?
Um, well...\nHow should I ask... hmm...
Look at me... is there anything\nthat seems off?
Huh?
Anything different from usual.\nAnything changed from before.
So? Anything, I wonder?
Ah. Did you cut your hair?
I did not!\nSay careless things and I'll get mad!
I don't really know...
Really? Really nothing changed?
If you're holding back out of concern,\nthat's fine.
I promise I won't get mad at anything\nyou say. So just say it straight!
Even if you tell me to say it straight...
Ah, wait. Hold on.\nStraight might be too much. It might hurt.
So, um,\nwrap it up gently,\nkindly, but honestly.
Something like that, please. Okay?
Even if you say 'okay?'... hmm...
Ah! So there IS something off!\nIt's noticeable!
That's why it's hard to say, right?\nRight?
Waaah, what a shock!\nI'll never recover!
Um, I don't understand.\nThere's nothing off at all.
I don't need comforting lies!\nYou were clearly holding back!
It's a misunderstanding. There's nothing off at all,\nI just didn't know what to say.
...Really? You're not lying?
Really, truly?\nI'll believe what you say, you know?
There's nothing changed about\nmy appearance, nowhere at all?
Phew... good. I'm relieved.
Um... what was that about?
Hm? That was, um...
Ahahaha. It's nothingg.\nAs long as everything's normal, it's fine.
So don't you worry about it.\nYou can forget it, okay?
Even if you say that, I'm curious.\nThe usually calm Rem getting\nthis flustered... what could...
Geez! It's fine!\nStop prying!
Keep saying mean things and\nI might start hating you!
I don't mean to be mean...\nI just want to know what happened.
When I say no, I mean NO!\nI'll never tell!
Well then, forget about today, okayy?
What was that about...?\nHmm, I'm curious...
Hmm...
Rem?\nYou're swaying. Is something wrong?
Ah, it's youu.\nI just can't get any strength\ninto my body...
Ah, I'm fine, okay?\nI know the cause myself.
So don't tell anyone.\nDon't worry about it. Okay?
Are you feeling unwell?
It's not a health problem.\nI'm just doing something...
What's the cause?
Geez, don't ask.\nIt's a little hard to say.
Anyway, I'm fine. Well then, see you...
Ugh...
Rem! Are you okay?!
Ugh... yeah, no good.\nDid I push myself too hard, I wonder...
My tummy... got emptyy.
Tummy...?\nRem, haven't you been eating?
N-no! I am! Of course\nI'm eating properly!
That wasn't why I almost collapsed.\nUm, well...
I've got a bit of a cold!\nSo I got all wobblyy.
See? Makes sense, right?\nBeing hungry, what a\nsilly reason that'd be...
Ah?!
Uuugh...
...Wh-what,\nlooking at me like that. Something to say?
No, it's not that I have something to say...
Fine, fine! I haven't been eating!\nThere, I said it!
But I decided not to eat,\nso it's not a problem!
Why aren't you eating properly?\nYou have to eat.
I know that... but... well...
Lately... I've gotten...
Huh? What?
...I've gotten faaat!!
The other day I got on the scale,\nand I'd gained compared to before!
It was a super, super\nshock, you know?!
Could it be... that time you asked me\nif anything about you had changed...
Y-yeah. I got worried\nwhether my looks had changed.
Jeez, look what you're making\na girl say. So embarrassing...
Sheesh. I was secretly dieting,\nand now it's out...
S-sorry...\nBut really, you look the same?\nYou don't need to worry so much...
I will worry!\nI may not look it, but I'm a maiden, you know!
It's embarrassing, so don't tell\nthe other girls I'm dieting, okay?
Keep it our little secret, okay?\nPromise?
Understood.\nI won't tell a soul.
(Worrying about her weight...\nshe has a girly side too.\nKind of an unexpected side of her...)
Hey, about what we talked about before -\nhow's it been lately?
Are you still having scary dreams?
Yeah, I had one yesterday too.\nMy right hand turned into a monster\nand ate me.
Oh my. That's a scary dream.
With nothing but scary dreams like this,\nI don't even want to sleep anymore.\nI don't want to dream at all...
Don't say things like that!
Huh...?
Ah... sorry.\nI got sharp with you...
But I don't want to hear you say\nsomething so sad as not wanting to dream anymore...
...I can't dream my own dreams, you see.
So I'm jealous of you.\nBeing able to dream your own dreams is\nwonderful, you know? And yet, not wanting to dream...
That's throwing away your own dreams, you know?\nThere's nothing sadder than that.
No matter how scary, those are your dreams.\nIt may be meddling, but let me say it.
Please, don't come to hate dreams.
But only dreaming scary dreams...
Sure, right now you might only\ndream scary dreams.
But someday, you might dream\na really fun dream, right?
I can't imagine dreaming\nfun dreams...
Dreams are, by nature, things\nyou wish for yourself.
Sadly, with today's technology,\npeople can't fully control their own dreams.
But if you wish strongly enough,\nthe chance of dreaming what you want to see goes up.\nThat's what I believe.
Really?
We studied this before, right?\nWhere, exactly, do we dream?
The brain, right?
You remembered! Good boyy!
The eyes, right?
Noo. We dream with the brain, right?\nWe studied so hard; you can't\nforget it alreadyy.
Anyway, the dreams you dream\nare dreams your brain made.
You know, people can't dream\nabout things their brain has no information on?
Then the reverse is true too.\nIf your brain strongly focuses on a scene,\nit's more likely to appear in your dreams.
It's just a hypothesis I came up with, but\nI don't think it's far off.
Think about the scene you truly want to see.\nAnd wish for it strongly.
If you keep wishing, someday\nsurely your dreams will answer.
You should be able to dream\nthe dream you want to see.
I see... thinking of it that way,\ndreaming sounds fun!
Aha. Good.\nI'm glad you won't hate dreams.
I'll think carefully about\nwhat kind of dream I want to dream.
Yeah! I think that's good!
Ah. I should get going.\nSee you.
If you decide what dream you want to dream,\ntell me then too. Hehe.
(Rem is so kind.\nShe's genuinely worried about me...)
(Still, the dream I want to dream...\nhmm. What would it be...)
Haaai. So, have you been thinking\nabout that thing?
You know. What dream you want to dream.\nCome up with anything?
Yeah. I thought about it.\nI've kind of settled on one.
Ooh, what, what?\nI want to hear what kind of dream.
No, it's a little embarrassing...
Nothing to be embarrassed aboutt.\nTalking about the dreams you want to see\nis a wonderful topic!
No, it's private...
Well... maybe so.\nBut that's a little cold.
Could it be...\nyou think I'd go blabbing to someone?
I'd never do that. I promise.\nIt'll be our secret, just you and me.\nSo, c'mon?
It's just for me, so what's the harm?\nTell me what dream it iss.
No, it's BECAUSE it's you, Rem,\nthat I can't tell you...
Huh? What do you mean?\nIs it a dream where I appear?
You've got a guilty look on your facee.\nNow I'm even more curious!
Hey, out with it!\nWhat are you doing with me in your dream?
What are the two of you planning to do?\nTell meee!
O-okay, I'll tell you, I'll tell you!\nUm... I thought it'd be a nice dream\nif I could go on a date with you, Rem...
With me... a date?
(Ahh. I said something weird...\nWill she think I'm creepy...)
Aha♪ That makes me happyy.
Huh? You're not put off?
Of course not!\nIn the dream world you can do anything, right?
And out of everything you could do\nin that anything-goes world, you chose\na date with me?
Nothing makes me happier.\nThanks.
U-uh...
(Anyone else would be creeped out.\nRem really is kind.)
Besides, there are lots of\ngirls around you, right?
They're all cute girls.\nAnd yet you chose me.
As a girl, of course I'm happy about that, right?
I didn't hesitate there.\nYou're number one, Rem.
Really? Hehehe.\nThat makes me sooo happy!
If only I could dream too.\nI might end up wanting to see you.
R-really?
Really. Why would I lie?
(This is going well.\nRem... could she maybe like me...)
Ah, I should get going.\nI wanted to hear more in detail, though.
If you'd like,\ntell me sometime what kind of date\nyou'd want in your dream.
Well then, see you!
(Rem. The dream I really want to dream\nis one I can't tell you about...)
...H-huh?\nWhere on earth am I?
Ufufu♪
Ah, Rem.\nI came to and found myself here...\nwhere is this?
Who cares about thatt?\nThere's something much more important...
Today... you're going on\na date with me, right?
Huh?
Did you forgett?\nThat's no good, no good.
Come on, let's go.\nStep into this classroom and\nwe'll be completely alone.
Come on, don't make that weird face.\nHurry, let's go, okay?
Um. I don't really get the situation...\n...H-huh? Rem?
This way♪
Hehe. So? Does it suit me, I wonder?
Wh-what's with that outfit?!\nWhen did you change?!
Geez, don't sweat the details.\nDon't say boring stuff.
More importantly, does it suit me?\nI wore this outfit for you, you know?
It's a little embarrassing, but...\nit's what you wished for. I'm fine.
What I wished for...?
That's right. You wanted to go on\na date with me dressed like this, right?
You thought it'd be the best if\nthe usually calm, cool me dressed\nlike this, right?
It's fine. If that's what you like,\nI'll oblige.
Now, let's go on our date.\nWhat should I do?
Link arms? Sit next to you?\nI'll do anything.
W-wait. It's true that I thought I'd like\nto go on a date with Rem dressed like that.
But... did I ever\ntell you that, Rem?
Geez. I'll get mad.\nYou've said it over and over.
Every day... before bed...\nover and over, strongly...
Inside your brain--
H-huh?\nHer voice is getting fainter--
Because this is a place where the impossible\nin reality can come true--
Ubu! A-are... you okay?!
You were dreaming.\nI just woke you up with this alarm!
(Ah, I see...\nThat was all a dream...)

You were dreaming another scary dream?!\nWere you okay?!
(S-sorry. That weird face...\nI was just grinning...)

Tell me the details!\nMaybe I can help!
